score: R=a+b*C+Z(B) dot w; q=sigmoid(R); R_behavior=Z(B) dot w
base_input: raw C, no standardization and no logit transform
base_regularization: sklearn C=1; b^2/(2*n) in mean-loss objective
implementation: sklearn LogisticRegression C=1 on [raw C, StandardScaler(B)/sqrt(n*lambda)], n=current fit training rows; active effective behavior coefficients=sklearn coefficients/sqrt(n*lambda); intercept unpenalized

optimizer.note: E1 recomputed with same optimizer precision; report numerical difference to legacy E1, not a new calibration method

off: exact E1 fitted on same training subset; not a large-lambda approximation
inner: GroupKFold5 on outer-training Dialogue only; pooled inner OOF Binary Brier selects penalty; tie tolerance1e-12 prefers off then stronger penalty
modality_pilot: M_joint only, each dataset/seed1475/modality separately fitted; joint must reproduce corresponding main experiment; no selecting primary modality from these OOF scores

evidence_tiers.engineering: correct target perturbation/mask/RNG already audited; mu/delta and learned score reproducible; all classification labels unchanged
evidence_tiers.behavior_response: quantify flip and confidence response and correctness associations; sensitivity is not correctness
evidence_tiers.preliminary_calibration_signal: primary vs E1 ECE and at least one of Brier/NLL improve in mean; other proper loss does not worsen; improved proper loss improves in >=3/5 seeds; confidence intervals may remain uncertain and are reported
evidence_tiers.robust_calibration_support: requires independent evidence beyond repeatedly inspected Validation; this run cannot establish it
evidence_tiers.raw_data_boundary: measurable behavior or weak exploratory signals can motivate a separate small raw-data mechanism/engineering Pilot; not proof of calibration effectiveness and no automatic raw modification

constraints: no CMERC training or GPU inference
no weights or raw feature edits
completion_batches: joint five-seed core score and all original-feature ablations verified and uploaded
single-modality seed1475 pilot verified and uploaded; integrated feasibility report
